notes.title: As the developer team, we would like to meet you.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42684199/d6db82de8733ee78ca5e56e765a1129a2e448a3b.png[/img]
[b]We care about your opinions on the game we have developed as an independent team. We are a gamer group just like you, so please let us know what you are wondering about our game and your suggestions. If you want, you can join our Discord channel and reach us from here.
[url=https://discord.gg/vXEZuqrtEP]Discord[/url]
